decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 3 - Details or the proposed car parking area shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before work on site begins. Such details shall include the means by which adequate sightlines can be achieved so as to safeguard pedestrian safety.
Condition : 4 - Details of a scheme of acoustic insulation shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The scheme should ensure compliance with British Standard 8233:1999.

Condition : 5 - Informative

There are public sewers crossing the site. No building will be permitted within 3 metres  of the sewers without Thames Water's approval. Thames Water's Developer Services Department can be contacted on 0845 8502777.
description: Erection of a new 2 bedroom two storey house.
